Surveyed 3 page-viewport pairs, 1556 rendered elements, measured 2026-10-10.

· 42 distinct colours render across the pages surveyed. 8 of them account for 97.7% of the colour on the page.
· 6 colours sit within a just-noticeable difference of a colour already in use and cannot be told apart by eye — together 9.6% of the colour on the page. The heaviest is #FFFFFF, which is 1.04 from #FCFCFC.
· Spacing follows no consistent step. The closest candidate is 4px and it explains only 87.9%. A 2px step would explain 99.6%, which is not a spacing system.
· 6 spacing values sit off that step, the most frequent being 2px, which is 2px from the nearest multiple.
· 13 distinct font sizes are in use across 12 steps. The sizes sit on roughly a 1.086 ratio.
· 5 of those sizes carry under 1% of the text each, which is the signature of a one-off rather than a step.
· 4 corner radii are in use, clustering into 4 steps.
· 11 distinct shadows are in use. An elevation scale usually has two or three.
